# Audible
> Audible is Amazon’s audiobook and spoken-word platform for listening to audiobooks, Audible Originals, podcasts, and series.

Audible offers subscription plans, a large catalog of spoken-word titles, mobile and web listening, and account support for memberships, credits, billing, and device use.

## Main
- [Audible Home](https://www.audible.com/): Main entry point for browsing audiobooks, Originals, podcasts, and membership offers.
- [Browse](https://www.audible.com/adblbestsellers): Discovery area for popular and bestselling audiobook titles.
- [Plans and Pricing](https://www.audible.com/ep/plan-picker): Compare Audible membership options, credits, and included listening benefits.
- [Gift Center](https://www.audible.com/ep/giftcenter): Purchase Audible memberships or audiobooks as gifts.
- [Member Benefits](https://www.audible.com/ep/memberbenefits): Overview of credits, sales, included catalog access, and listening perks.

## Discover and Browse
- [Best Sellers](https://www.audible.com/adblbestsellers): Browse bestselling audiobooks across major categories and formats.
- [New Releases](https://www.audible.com/newreleases): Explore recently released audiobooks and spoken-word titles.
- [Coming Soon](https://www.audible.com/coming-soon): Preview upcoming audiobook releases available for preorder or watchlisting.
- [Audible Originals](https://www.audible.com/ep/audible-originals): Discover exclusive Audible-produced series, stories, and performances.
- [Podcasts](https://www.audible.com/ep/podcasts): Find podcasts available through Audible listening apps and membership.
- [Editors' Picks](https://www.audible.com/ep/editors-picks): Curated recommendations selected by Audible editors.
- [Top Plus Listens](https://www.audible.com/ep/top-plus-listens): Popular titles included in the Audible Plus catalog.

## Categories
- [Mystery, Thriller & Suspense](https://www.audible.com/cat/Mystery-Thriller-Suspense-Audiobooks/18574627011): Category page for crime, thriller, and suspense audiobooks.
- [Science Fiction & Fantasy](https://www.audible.com/cat/Science-Fiction-Fantasy-Audiobooks/18580606011): Browse science fiction and fantasy audiobooks and series.
- [Romance](https://www.audible.com/cat/Romance-Audiobooks/18580518011): Explore romance audiobooks across subgenres and tropes.
- [Biographies & Memoirs](https://www.audible.com/cat/Biographies-Memoirs-Audiobooks/18571918011): Listen to memoirs, autobiographies, and biographical nonfiction.
- [Business & Careers](https://www.audible.com/cat/Business-Careers-Audiobooks/18572042011): Audiobooks focused on leadership, management, and professional development.
- [Health & Wellness](https://www.audible.com/cat/Health-Wellness-Audiobooks/18573747011): Spoken-word titles on health, fitness, and personal wellbeing.
- [Kids](https://www.audible.com/cat/Childrens-Audiobooks/18572091011): Audiobooks for children, middle grade listeners, and families.

## Membership and Account Help
- [Help Center](https://help.audible.com/): Central support portal for account, billing, and listening help.
- [Manage Membership](https://help.audible.com/s/article/manage-membership?language=en_US): Help for changing, pausing, or canceling an Audible membership.
- [Return a Title](https://help.audible.com/s/article/can-i-return-my-book?language=en_US): Policy and steps for returning eligible audiobook purchases.
- [Credits Explained](https://help.audible.com/s/article/what-are-credits?language=en_US): Explanation of how Audible credits work and when they expire.
- [Billing and Payments](https://help.audible.com/s/topic/0TO4N000000TNoGWAW/billing-and-payments?language=en_US): Support articles for charges, payment methods, and invoices.
- [Account and Login](https://help.audible.com/s/topic/0TO4N000000TNnQWAW/account-settings?language=en_US): Help with sign-in, account settings, and profile management.
- [Contact Us](https://help.audible.com/s/contact-us?language=en_US): Support contact options for Audible customer service.

## Apps and Listening
- [How to Listen](https://www.audible.com/ep/howtolisten): Overview of listening on mobile apps, web, and supported devices.
- [Audible Apps](https://www.audible.com/apps): Download Audible apps for supported platforms and devices.
- [Apple iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/audible-audio-entertainment/id379693831): Audible app for iPhone and iPad listening.
- [Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.audible.application): Audible app for Android phones and tablets.
- [Listen with Alexa](https://help.audible.com/s/article/listen-with-alexa?language=en_US): Use Alexa-enabled devices to play Audible content.
- [Offline Listening](https://help.audible.com/s/article/download-audiobooks-in-the-audible-for-ios-app?language=en_US): Download titles for offline playback in the Audible app.

## Gift and Purchase Options
- [Gift Center](https://www.audible.com/ep/giftcenter): Hub for gifting memberships and individual audiobook titles.
- [Gift a Membership](https://www.audible.com/ep/giftcenter/membership): Send Audible membership gifts for fixed subscription durations.
- [Gift an Audiobook](https://help.audible.com/s/article/can-i-purchase-an-audiobook-for-someone-else?language=en_US): Learn how to buy and send an audiobook as a gift.
- [Redeem a Gift](https://help.audible.com/s/article/how-do-i-redeem-a-gift-membership?language=en_US): Instructions for redeeming Audible gift memberships.
- [Buy Extra Credits](https://help.audible.com/s/article/can-i-buy-more-credits?language=en_US): Support information for purchasing additional credits.

## Authors, Narrators, and Series
- [Authors on Audible](https://www.audible.com/search?searchProvider=author): Search Audible’s catalog by author.
- [Narrators on Audible](https://www.audible.com/search?searchProvider=narrator): Search audiobooks by narrator or performer.
- [Series on Audible](https://www.audible.com/series): Browse audiobook series and multi-book collections.
- [Celebrity Narrators](https://www.audible.com/ep/celebrity-narrators): Explore titles performed by well-known actors and public figures.
- [Full Cast Audio](https://www.audible.com/search?keywords=full+cast): Search for dramatized and ensemble-cast audiobook productions.

## Business and Partners
- [Audible for Business](https://business.audible.com/): Workplace offering for employee listening, learning, and engagement.
- [Publisher and Author Information](https://www.audible.com/ep/publishing): Information about publishing and distributing audiobooks through Audible.
- [ACX](https://www.acx.com/): Audiobook creation exchange for authors, narrators, and rights holders.
- [Amazon Publishing](https://amazonpublishing.amazon.com/): Amazon publishing resources relevant to authors and content creation.

## Legal and Policies
- [Conditions of Use](https://www.audible.com/legal/conditions-of-use): Terms governing use of Audible websites, apps, and services.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.audible.com/legal/privacy-notice): Details on data collection, use, and privacy practices.
- [Interest-Based Ads](https://www.audible.com/legal/interest-based-ads): Information about advertising preferences and personalized ads.
- [Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information](https://www.audible.com/privacy/ccpa): Privacy choices for eligible U.S. residents.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.audible.com/ep/accessibility): Accessibility information for Audible services and experiences.
